english.title: Fail to produce a book / register in contravention of a requirement to retain
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to comply with a requirement made by an officer under section 99(1) of the Transport Act 1968 to produce a book or register, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BOOK OR REGISTER..), which you were required by article 14(2) of the Community Recording Equipment Regulation to retain
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:

(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
